# Opening Bell and Opening Cross

> Opening Cross is an open call-auction protocol on Solana: orders collect during a call period, and when it closes every filled order trades at one uniform clearing price. Opening Bell is the web app built on it. Status: early development on Solana devnet only. No mainnet deployment, no external audit, no real users; nothing here is an offer of securities or investment advice. Every figure in the API comes from the chain or from an indexer that reconciles against it.

Two names, one thing: "Opening Cross" is the protocol (programs, SDK, API, licence Apache-2.0); "Opening Bell" is the app and company brand. Integers in the API are decimal strings. Errors are a 4xx status with `{ "error": "..." }`. The full text of this file, with parameters and the verification procedures, is at /llms-full.txt.

Base URLs (the current devnet deployment; they can change, so read them from the site if a call fails):
- Web app: https://opening-bell-psi.vercel.app
- API: https://98-87-59-136.sslip.io

## Web pages

- [Crosses](https://opening-bell-psi.vercel.app/crosses): every cross, filterable by state, bid disclosure and supply mode; the filter state is in the URL.
- [Calendar](https://opening-bell-psi.vercel.app/calendar): crosses by their real windows (open now, opening soon, closed), with an .ics download for each upcoming one.
- [Track record](https://opening-bell-psi.vercel.app/accuracy): every signed price band, counted by outcome, misses included.
- [Premium monitor](https://opening-bell-psi.vercel.app/premium): executable premium of Solana stock tokens against a reference.
- [Status](https://opening-bell-psi.vercel.app/status): live health of the API, RPC and indexer, and who holds power over the deployed programs.
- [Developers](https://opening-bell-psi.vercel.app/developers): packages, API and quickstart.

## API (read-only GET routes)

- GET /v1/health: indexed slot, indexer heartbeat, reconciliation alerts in the last hour.
- GET /v1/stats: protocol totals and the network they were counted on.
- GET /v1/programs: which release of cross_core, treasury and cross_settle is deployed on this cluster, read from the program bytes, and what each release can and cannot do (the extended instructions are not deployed to devnet yet).
- GET /v1/dashboard: every public figure in one answer; each section names the route it came from, and a section that failed or timed out says so and may be shown stale with its age.
- GET /v1/crosses?state=&limit=: crosses, newest first (`state` is Live, Cleared, NoPrint or Finalized; `limit` 1 to 200, default 50).
- GET /v1/crosses/:address: one cross, read from chain.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/orders: indexed orders with fills.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/book: the resting book and the price it would clear at now.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/proof: the clearing recomputed independently from the on-chain book.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/promise: the latest signed price band for a cross.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/authenticity: is each token of this cross the issuer's real token (mainnet mints only).
- GET /v1/promises/signer: the key that signs promises.
- GET /v1/promises/:id: a signed promise with its grade and anchor proof.
- GET /v1/promises/:id/inputs: the book a promise was computed from.
- GET /v1/accuracy: every signed band counted by outcome.
- GET /v1/tokens/:mint/authenticity: is this the issuer's real token (mainnet mints only).
- GET /v1/tokens/:mint/safety: what the issuer of a token can do to escrowed balances (pause, freeze, permanent delegate, transfer hook, fee, mint authority), with a verdict: blocked, halted, disclosures or clear.
- GET /v1/router/quote?base=&quote=&side=&amount=: ranked venues for one order (live crosses of the pair, the Meteora DAMM v2 pool and DLMM pair the adapters open for it, Jupiter on mainnet), each exclusion with its reason. Nothing is signed.
- GET /v1/replay/:address: every on-chain event of one cross in order, from the indexed event log.
- GET /v1/replay?days=&limit=: crosses that opened in the last days (default 30) with outcome, order counts and timings.
- GET /v1/premium/summary?days=: stock-token premium by order size and market session.
- GET /v1/premium/latest: the newest premium measurement per token.
- GET /v1/metrics/execution: what bidders actually got over every finalized cross that printed: fill rate, price improvement, refund share, close-to-finalized time, each with its sample size and method.
- GET /v1/metrics/fairness?threshold=: how concentrated fills are across wallets, with a confidence interval over crosses.
- GET /v1/metrics/external-flow: how much of the flow comes from wallets that are not ours.
- GET /v1/orders?addresses=: orders by address, at most 100.
- GET /v1/orders/:address: one order.
- GET /v1/owners/:owner/orders: all orders of one wallet.
- WS /v1/stream?cross=: a WebSocket of every event as the indexer commits it, optionally for one cross.

## Unsigned transactions (POST)

These return transactions for your wallet to sign and send. The API never holds keys and never signs for anyone.

- POST /v1/route/quote
- POST /v1/tx/create-cross
- POST /v1/tx/place-order
- POST /v1/tx/cancel
- POST /v1/tx/reveal
- POST /v1/tx/settle
- POST /v1/tx/claim
- POST /v1/tx/finalize
- POST /v1/tx/init-shards

## Rules, treasury and settlement (extended programs)

The programs behind these routes were extended in Wave 2D and are proved on LiteSVM and a local validator; they are **not deployed on devnet yet** (the operator funding step H27), so a transaction for a new instruction is built correctly and the deployed program refuses it. A cross created before the upgrade has no rules and every route answers for it as for a cross with every rule off. Full request and response shapes: [the rules, treasury and settlement API notes](https://github.com/Pratiikpy/opening-cross/blob/main/docs/api/W3A-rules-treasury-settle.md).

Reads:

- GET /v1/crosses/:address/rules: the rules a cross carries (print guards, ending and draw, identity limits, classes, lockups, insiders and bond, referral, oracle median), its draw and neutrality state and what they call for; null with a note for a cross without rules.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/indicative: the indicative clearing price; in coarse bands (nearest of eight prices, imbalance as a direction) while the ending period is open. A display rule, not secrecy: the chain account is public.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/ending: the ending period: buckets with the orders in each, the drawn last counted bucket, the extension state.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/challenges: insider challenges filed against a cross, with their outcome.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/proof/draws: the fairness proof with the draw events the index holds, so an ending drawn before a later draw replaced the stored seed is checked too.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/settlement: the venue a settlement adapter opened for a cross, the partner payouts and the greenshoe.
- GET /v1/owners/:owner/lockups?cross=: a wallet's locked fills with what has been released and what can be released now.
- GET /v1/halts/:baseMint: the halt state of a base mint: halted or not, why, who may halt and resume it.
- GET /v1/feeds/:baseMint: the lender print feed of a base mint: publishers, latest print, recorded prints.
- GET /v1/series/:address: a recurring series: schedule, whether it runs, the crosses it spawned.
- GET /v1/series?authority=: recurring series, optionally of one authority.
- GET /v1/treasuries/:address/ext: the terms and live state of a treasury's extension (votes, NAV window, distributions, revenue rounds, disclosure, assignment gate, wind-down), or extended: false.
- GET /v1/treasuries/:address/proposals: holder proposals with tally, quorum needed and status.
- GET /v1/treasuries/:address/proposals/:id?voter=: one proposal, and a voter's locked votes on it.
- GET /v1/treasuries/:address/positions/:owner: what a wallet holds, has staked and can claim from a treasury.
- GET /v1/treasuries/:address/grants: team grants with lockups, milestones and status.
- GET /v1/treasuries/:address/rounds: revenue rounds: open, awaiting payment, late, paid or missed, with the attestation each needs.
- GET /v1/treasuries/:address/events?name=&limit=: indexed treasury events (votes, distributions, grants, disclosures).

Unsigned transactions (all POST, same conventions as above):

- POST /v1/rules/check: the create-cross body plus rules; answers whether the program would accept the rules, with each refusal by field. Builds nothing.
- POST /v1/tx/create-cross-ruled: create-cross with rules: the creation and set_rules in one transaction, then the shards, bucket shards, class book and lock vault the rules call for.
- POST /v1/tx/place-order-ext: place an order with an allocation class (1 small verified, 2 accepts a lockup, 3 priority) and a lockup; answers the ending bucket it names and how long it is right for.
- POST /v1/tx/settle-ext: settle with the oracle accounts named.
- POST /v1/tx/draw-begin: first step of a draw (drawn ending, lottery, drawn extension). Anyone may send it.
- POST /v1/tx/draw-finish: second step of a draw, at least 20 slots later.
- POST /v1/tx/release-locked: pay the vested part of a lockup to its owner.
- POST /v1/tx/push-refunds: return up to 12 refund-only orders to their owners in one transaction.
- POST /v1/tx/close-applicant: close a finished identity-limit record.
- POST /v1/tx/challenge-insider: file a challenge that a wallet is an undeclared insider.
- POST /v1/tx/resolve-challenge: the arbiter's ruling on a challenge.
- POST /v1/tx/expire-challenge: close a challenge the arbiter left unanswered for 14 days.
- POST /v1/tx/set-arbiter: the protocol admin names the arbiter.
- POST /v1/tx/init-halt-state: create the halt state of a base mint.
- POST /v1/tx/set-halt: halt crosses of a base mint.
- POST /v1/tx/set-corporate-action: set or clear the corporate-action flag.
- POST /v1/tx/sync-pause: copy a pausable mint's pause flag into its halt state.
- POST /v1/tx/observe-price: feed a verified Pyth update to the circuit breaker.
- POST /v1/tx/init-print-feed: create the lender print feed of a base mint.
- POST /v1/tx/set-feed-publishers: change who may move the lender print feed.
- POST /v1/tx/create-series: create a recurring series.
- POST /v1/tx/spawn-next: spawn the next cross of a series.
- POST /v1/tx/set-series-active: pause or resume a series.
- POST /v1/tx/series-withdraw: withdraw from a series' own token account.
- POST /v1/tx/claim-partner-fee: claim a DBC partner's trading fees to the fee recipient.
- POST /v1/tx/withdraw-partner-surplus: after migration: the partner's share of the surplus quote to the issuer.
- POST /v1/tx/withdraw-partner-migration-fee: after migration: the partner's slice of the migration fee to the fee recipient.
- POST /v1/tx/claim-partner-pool-creation-fee: the pool-creation fee, in lamports, to the fee recipient.
- POST /v1/tx/claim-pol-fees: fees of the protocol-owned liquidity position to the issuer.
- POST /v1/tx/create-greenshoe: commit a budget to standing bids under the clearing price.
- POST /v1/tx/deploy-greenshoe-bid: place one greenshoe level; a fresh keypair signs next to the payer.
- POST /v1/tx/settle-greenshoe-level: after the week: cancel a level and close its order.
- POST /v1/tx/finish-greenshoe: burn what the bids bought and return the unspent budget to the issuer.
- POST /v1/tx/open-dbc-pool: open the locked, compounding DBC continuation at the clearing price and bind the base token (the creator signs).
- POST /v1/tx/bind-dbc-mint: bind the base token once the DBC pool exists.
- POST /v1/tx/seed-damm-v2: open a DAMM v2 pool at the clearing price: plain, batch-opened, with an Alpha Vault, with its liquidity locked.
- POST /v1/tx/open-dlmm-pair: open a DLMM pair around the clearing price: plain, batch-opened or behind Token Badges.
- POST /v1/tx/seed-raydium-cpmm: open a Raydium CPMM pool at the clearing price.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/venues: which venues a cross has opened and which can be opened now.
- POST /v1/tx/alpha-vault-init: create the Alpha Vault of a batch-opened DAMM v2 pool.
- POST /v1/tx/alpha-vault-deposit: deposit quote tokens into an Alpha Vault.
- POST /v1/tx/alpha-vault-fill: anyone fills the vault from the pool.
- POST /v1/tx/alpha-vault-claim: claim what the vault bought.
- POST /v1/tx/alpha-vault-withdraw-remaining: take back what an oversubscribed pro-rata vault did not use.
- POST /v1/tx/alpha-vault-withdraw: take back a deposit from an Alpha Vault while its deposit window is open.
- POST /v1/tx/alpha-vault-close-escrow: close a vault deposit escrow once it is empty and get its rent back.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/alpha-vault: the Alpha Vault of a cross's pool and an owner's escrow.
- POST /v1/tx/metlock-create: lock tokens for a recipient on a vesting schedule in Met Lock.
- POST /v1/tx/metlock-claim: the recipient claims what has vested.
- GET /v1/metlock/escrows/:escrow: a Met Lock escrow: total, vested, claimable.
- POST /v1/tx/fee-share-create: create a Dynamic Fee Sharing vault for two to five recipients.
- POST /v1/tx/fee-share-fund: fund a fee-sharing vault.
- POST /v1/tx/fee-share-claim: a recipient claims their share.
- POST /v1/tx/fee-share-transfer-position: hand a DAMM v2 position to the vault; one way.
- POST /v1/tx/fee-share-fund-from-damm: pull the position's fees into the vault.
- GET /v1/fee-share/:base/:mint: a fee-sharing vault and its shares.
- GET /v1/pools: the Meteora DAMM v2 pool and DLMM pair the adapters open for a base and quote mint: price, reserves, fee, depth both ways and where each figure was read.
- GET /v1/pools/:address: one pool's health: price, reserves, fee, depth and price impact both ways, the bin ladder of a DLMM pair, persistence since the API first read it.
- GET /v1/pools/route: the router's ranking for an order with the pools merged in and the pools it read named (the same pools are in GET /v1/router/quote).
- GET /v1/pools/by-cross/:address: the issuer's view of a cross's liquidity: the pools of its token pair and their health.
- GET /v1/pools/summary: the liquidity section of the dashboard: the pools of recent crosses in one answer.
- GET /v1/depth/cross/:address: how much a cross takes before its price moves, beside what its pools take, for a ladder of sizes.
- POST /v1/pools/swap-tx: an unsigned swap on a DAMM v2 pool or DLMM pair for a wallet, with the quote it was built from, a minimum output the program enforces, and the accounts it opens.
- GET /v1/treasuries: indexed treasuries with their live chain state.
- GET /v1/treasuries/:address: one treasury: terms, balances and attestation read from chain, recent events, rights cards, disclosure.
- GET /v1/treasuries/:address/updates: the owner's signed updates, each with its anchor and the check against the program's Spent events.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/updates: submit a signed update and the Memo transaction that anchors it.
- GET /v1/treasuries/:address/movements?kind=&direction=&asset=&teamOutflow=&counterparty=&minAmount=&sinceSlot=&before=&limit=: every event that moved value across the treasury's boundary, newest first, paged; 400 for a malformed filter.
- GET /v1/treasuries/:address/movements/totals?sinceSlot=: what the treasury moved, summed by kind, direction and asset (quote and coin are never added together).
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/receipt-attestation?optional=1: the signed, anchored attestation of a settled cross's receipt, with its Merkle proof to the anchor on chain; 404 until one exists, or a plain 200 with attestation: null when optional=1.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/damm-rewards: the reward slots of the cross's DAMM v2 pool: funder, mint, duration, what is funded and what a position can claim.
- POST /v1/tx/damm-reward-init: open a reward slot on the pool (the pool creator signs).
- POST /v1/tx/damm-reward-fund: fund a reward slot; the reward streams to positions in proportion to liquidity.
- POST /v1/tx/damm-reward-claim: a position owner claims its reward.
- POST /v1/tx/damm-reward-update-funder: hand a reward slot to another funder.
- POST /v1/tx/damm-reward-update-duration: change a reward slot's duration once its stream has ended.
- POST /v1/tx/damm-reward-withdraw-ineligible: the funder takes back the reward that streamed while the pool had no liquidity, once the stream has ended.
- POST /v1/tx/damm-lp-join: join the cross's DAMM v2 pool as a liquidity provider: a new position owned by the wallet, holding a share of the pool's liquidity at its current ratio.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/ladder?position=: the conviction ladder on the cross's DLMM pair: its bins, what has filled and what is left.
- POST /v1/tx/ladder-limit-place: lay the ladder as DLMM limit orders.
- POST /v1/tx/ladder-limit-cancel: cancel limit-order bins and take back what they hold.
- POST /v1/tx/ladder-limit-close: close a limit-order account and get its rent back.
- POST /v1/tx/ladder-rebalance-withdraw: step 1 of a rebalance: withdraw the whole ladder position, claim its fees and close it.
- POST /v1/tx/ladder-rebalance-relay: step 2 of a rebalance: lay the base again above the new price.
- POST /v1/tx/ladder-position-place: the first placement of a position ladder, optionally locked until a time (only while the pair is still closed).
- POST /v1/tx/presale-deposit: a buyer deposits quote tokens into the fixed-price tranche a cross opened.
- POST /v1/tx/presale-claim: a buyer claims the tokens a completed tranche bought (the quote refund of a failed sale is not built yet).
- POST /v1/tx/presale-creator-withdraw: the creator withdraws the raise of a completed tranche, or the base supply of a failed one.
- POST /v1/curve/calibrate: turn a book of bids (or a cross's) into the segment weights of a launch curve whose stored liquidity ratios equal the demand.
- GET /v1/arbiter: who rules on insider challenges, if anyone has been named.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/challenge-state: the open challenges of a cross, the bond, the window and who can rule.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/init-ext: extend a treasury once (votes, NAV window, distributions, revenue rounds, disclosure, assignment gate, wind-down); also the flagship preset.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/propose: a holder proposal: spend, open the NAV window, close it.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/vote: vote with coins that stay locked until the vote ends.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/reclaim-vote: take the locked coins back after the vote.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/execute-proposal: run a proposal that passed and waited out its timelock.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/nav-redeem: burn coins for their share of the vault at NAV while a window is open.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/stake: stake coins to earn distributions.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/unstake: take staked coins back.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/deposit-distribution: add quote tokens for the stakers.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/claim-distribution: claim earned distributions.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/pay-round: pay the stakers' share of an attested revenue round.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/mark-missed: mark a late revenue round missed; opens the NAV exit.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/release-tranche: release the team's tranche for a qualifying round.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/create-grant: escrow a team grant with milestones.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/release-milestone: release a milestone to the beneficiary.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/expire-grant: burn a grant's unearned coins after it expires.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/post-disclosure: the team posts a disclosure.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/request-disclosure: a holder requests a disclosure, starting a clock.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/record-assignment: record counsel's IP-assignment attestation.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/sweep-unclaimed: after the wind-down window, send what holders did not redeem to the recovery account.
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/spend: the team spends within its allowance (deployed).
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/record-attested: record a renewed attestation (deployed).
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/record-lapse: record a lapsed attestation (deployed).
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/trigger-liquidation: start the liquidation after the grace period (deployed).
- POST /v1/treasuries/:address/tx/redeem: redeem coins at the liquidation snapshot (deployed).

## The Wave 3D programs (built and proved locally, not on devnet yet)

Mandates, conviction locks, baskets, stake-bonded listing, the adversarial bounty, the backing watchdog and graduation by holder vote, plus the fixed-price tranche and the MetaDAO adapter of `cross_settle`. Their programs are proved on LiteSVM and a local validator and are not deployed to devnet until the operations key is funded (docs/HUMAN_TASKS.md H27, H43): a transaction route answers 409 `PROGRAM_NOT_DEPLOYED` until then, and a read says `release.deployed: false`. GET /v1/programs says which are available.

- POST /v1/tx/mandate-create: create an auto-invest mandate: an owner funds a vault and names one agent who can only place buy orders inside the owner's limits (per order, lifetime cap, at most 25% of a cross's supply, expiry, allow list).
- POST /v1/tx/mandate-fund: add quote tokens to a mandate's vault and SOL to its signer account (the owner).
- POST /v1/tx/mandate-set-limits: replace a mandate's limits (the owner; never on a revoked mandate).
- POST /v1/tx/mandate-revoke: the kill switch: immediate and permanent (the owner).
- POST /v1/tx/mandate-withdraw: take quote tokens out of the vault, at any time (the owner).
- POST /v1/tx/mandate-withdraw-lamports: take SOL out of the mandate's signer account; it keeps the rent of an empty account or is emptied (the owner).
- POST /v1/tx/mandate-sweep: send the base token a filled order left in the mandate to the owner (anyone).
- POST /v1/tx/mandate-place-order: the agent's buy order, inside the limits: refused with the program's own reason when a limit would be.
- POST /v1/tx/mandate-cancel-order: cancel a mandate's order while its cross takes cancels; the refund goes to the vault (owner or agent).
- POST /v1/tx/mandate-reveal-order: reveal a mandate's sealed order (owner or agent).
- POST /v1/mandates/check-transaction: run on a transaction before signing it with an agent key: ok only for place_order, cancel_order, reveal_order and compute-budget instructions.
- GET /v1/mandates/:address: a mandate from chain: limits, committed, vault and SOL balances, status, what stops the agent now.
- GET /v1/mandates: mandates from the index (?owner=&agent=&limit=).
- GET /v1/owners/:owner/mandates: an owner's mandates.
- GET /v1/mandates/:address/activity: a mandate's events and the orders it placed.
- POST /v1/tx/conviction-lock: lock tokens with no early exit for a day to four years.
- POST /v1/tx/conviction-unlock: take the tokens back once the lock has run.
- POST /v1/tx/conviction-claim-badge: mint the soulbound badge that counts the token-days kept locked, once per lock.
- POST /v1/tx/conviction-close-lock: close a lock whose tokens are back and whose badge is claimed.
- GET /v1/conviction/locks/:address: one conviction lock from chain.
- GET /v1/owners/:owner/conviction: a wallet's conviction locks and badges.
- GET /v1/conviction/mints/:mint: what is locked behind a token.
- POST /v1/tx/basket-create: create a basket token backed by fixed amounts of one to eight tokens.
- POST /v1/tx/basket-mint: mint shares: every component paid in, rounded up.
- POST /v1/tx/basket-redeem: redeem shares: every component paid out, rounded down.
- GET /v1/baskets/:address: a basket from chain: components, vault balances, share supply, backing per share, solvency.
- GET /v1/baskets/:address/quote: what a mint costs or a redemption pays per component (?shares=&side=mint|redeem).
- GET /v1/baskets: baskets from the index.
- POST /v1/tx/listing-create-venue: create a listing venue with fixed terms: the bond token, the minimum bond, the release delay, where a slashed bond goes.
- POST /v1/tx/listing-open-bond: open a lister's bond on a venue.
- POST /v1/tx/listing-deposit-bond: deposit into a bond.
- POST /v1/tx/listing-withdraw-bond: withdraw the part of a bond no open listing has set aside.
- POST /v1/tx/listing-list-cross: list a cross you created that still takes orders; the venue's minimum bond is set aside.
- POST /v1/tx/listing-release: release a listing's bond after the delay when its cross ended well (anyone).
- POST /v1/tx/listing-slash: slash a listing's bond to the venue when its cross ended because its settlement never happened (anyone).
- GET /v1/listing/venues/:venue: a venue's terms from chain, and a lister's bond on it (?lister=).
- GET /v1/listing/venues: venues from the index.
- GET /v1/listing/venues/:venue/listings: a venue's listings.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/listings: the venues that listed a cross.
- GET /v1/listing/listings/:address: one listing and what can be done with it now: release, slash, wait or settled.
- POST /v1/tx/bounty-create: create an adversarial bounty: a pool committed for at least thirty days, a reward per invariant, an arbiter.
- POST /v1/tx/bounty-fund: add to a bounty's pool (anyone).
- POST /v1/tx/bounty-claim-invariant: claim the reward for a cross account that breaks one of eleven invariants; paid by the program, once per invariant.
- POST /v1/tx/bounty-award: the arbiter awards a report the chain cannot check, before the expiry.
- POST /v1/tx/bounty-withdraw: the sponsor withdraws, only from the expiry on.
- GET /v1/bounties/:address: a bounty from chain: the pool, the expiry, what each invariant pays and whether it has paid.
- GET /v1/bounties: bounties from the index.
- GET /v1/bounties/:address/payouts: what a bounty paid and to whom.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/invariants: which of the eleven invariants a cross account breaks right now (none for an honest cross).
- POST /v1/tx/backing-init-halt-state: create a halt state that names the backing watchdog as its venue signer.
- POST /v1/tx/backing-create-policy: opt an asset in to the automatic pause: the attester, the committed coverage, the longest age of a statement.
- POST /v1/tx/backing-attest: the policy's attester states the backing, in the mint's own atoms.
- POST /v1/tx/backing-check: anyone halts an opted-in asset whose attested backing is missing, stale or short.
- GET /v1/assets/:mint/backing: an asset's backing policy, last statement, live supply, verdict now and halt state.
- GET /v1/backing/policies: opted-in assets from the index.
- POST /v1/tx/graduate-init-charter: set the charter of a governed cross before its first order: quorum, voting window, optional volume gate.
- POST /v1/tx/graduate-start-round: the creator opens a graduation vote once the cross is finalized.
- POST /v1/tx/graduate-cast-vote: lock tokens behind a venue (DAMM v2, DLMM, Raydium CPMM or MetaDAO) until the window ends.
- POST /v1/tx/graduate-post-volume: the charter's attester states the organic volume.
- POST /v1/tx/graduate-finalize-round: anyone decides a round after its window: quorum and a strict majority.
- POST /v1/tx/graduate-publish-outcome: anyone publishes the outcome of a passed round, the account the seeding instructions read.
- POST /v1/tx/graduate-withdraw-vote: take locked tokens back after the window.
- GET /v1/crosses/:address/graduation: the charter, every round with its tally and verdict now, the outcome and the seeding instruction it allows.
- GET /v1/graduation/rounds/:round: one round, and a voter's lock (?voter=).
- POST /v1/tx/open-fixed-price-presale: open a fixed-price tranche at exactly the clearing price through Meteora's Presale Vault (the creator signs).
- POST /v1/tx/seed-futarchy-dao: open a MetaDAO futarchy DAO whose spot pool starts at the clearing price (legacy SPL tokens only).

## Verify a cross yourself

- [README](https://github.com/Pratiikpy/opening-cross/blob/main/README.md): `pnpm --filter @opening-cross/verifier verify <cross-address> --rpc <your RPC URL>` recomputes a cleared cross from its on-chain book and exits 0 only when it matches.
- [Clearing rule (ADR-0003)](https://github.com/Pratiikpy/opening-cross/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-clearing-rule.md)
- [Conformance vectors](https://github.com/Pratiikpy/opening-cross/blob/main/docs/evidence/D5-conformance.md)
- [OCIP-1 interface specification](https://github.com/Pratiikpy/opening-cross/blob/main/docs/spec/OCIP-1.md): accounts, instructions, the clearing rule, the fairness proof and the conformance vectors (draft; devnet only, no audit).

## Signed price bands

- [Signed, graded promises (ADR-0015)](https://github.com/Pratiikpy/opening-cross/blob/main/docs/adr/0015-signed-graded-promises.md): format `opening-cross/promise/v1`, signature domain `opening-cross/promise/v1\n`, id = SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical body.
